briefdescription.para: LDM performance benchmarks for the ethics_ai module.

detaileddescription.para: All benchmarks use deterministic stub-LLM fixtures (no real LLM required). Canonical RNG seed: kCanonicalRngSeed = 42 (MEASUREMENT_HYGIENE.md §1). UseRealTime() applied to benchmarks with async/parallel I/O-bound paths (MEASUREMENT_HYGIENE.md §4).
Hard gates define the release acceptance criteria for LDM Ebene-1/3.
